expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Three nights, the wall and the pandas. For families with small children this is the right length for Beijing.
expert.tip: Get to the panda house when the zoo opens. The pandas are active for the first hour and asleep by eleven.

summary: Four days in the capital: the Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace, then the panda house at Beijing Zoo, with free time in the city around them.
included: Included: 3 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; a full day guided tour of the Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace; Beijing Zoo tickets with the panda house.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
